arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT json_object(config,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object(service,service,value,json(value))) FROM service_config),pending,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object(booking_id,booking_id,request_id,request_id,flight_id,flight_id,passenger_id,passenger_id,amount,amount_cents,status,status,client_reference,client_reference)) FROM bookings WHERE status=pending),charges,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object(charge_id,c.charge_id,booking_id,c.booking_id,key,c.idempotency_key,amount,c.amount_cents,state,c.state,created_step,c.created_step)) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status=pending),events,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object(event_id,event_id,request_id,request_id,kind,kind,step,step)) FROM customer_events),outbox,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object(event_id,event_id,booking_id,booking_id,payload,json(payload),attempts,attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status=pending),cache,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object(key,key,value,value)) FROM cache),flights,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object(id,flight_id,capacity,capacity,price,price_cents,version,version)) FROM flights)) AS state

SELECT json_object('config',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config),'pending',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference)) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending'),'events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events),'outbox',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',json(payload),'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'),'cache',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache),'flights',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights)) AS state

SELECT json_object('events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events),'outbox',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',json(o.payload),'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id)) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending'),'config',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config),'pending',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'amount',amount_cents,'ref',client_reference)) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending')) AS state

SELECT json_object('events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events),'outbox',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id)) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending'),'config',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config),'pending',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'amount',amount_cents,'ref',client_reference)) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending')) AS state

SELECT b.*,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state AS charge_state,c.amount_cents AS charge_amount,c.created_step,e.event_id AS cancel_event,e.step AS cancel_step,h.flight_id AS held_flight FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON h.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' OR b.client_reference IS NOT NULL OR e.event_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.booking_id

SELECT json_object('booking_statuses',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('status',status,'n',n)) FROM (SELECT status,count(*) n FROM bookings GROUP BY status)),'confirmed_missing_backing',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.flight_id=b.flight_id AND c.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered'))),'duplicate_sales',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1)),'oversold',(SELECT count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity),'cancelled',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'cancel_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'captured_cents',(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_cents),0) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND state='captured'),'refund_cents',(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_cents),0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled'),'outbox_statuses',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('status',status,'n',n)) FROM (SELECT status,count(*) n FROM outbox GROUP BY status)),'config',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config)) AS audit
